newsitem.title: USA: CNA Financial names Mondale to its board. [CORRECTED 23:41 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CNA Financial names Mondale to its board. [CORRECTED 23:41 GMT]

text.p: CNA Financial Corp said Wednesday it named Walter Mondale, former vice president of the United States, to its board of directors.
The company said Mondale previously served as a director from 1985 until 1993 (corrects), when he resigned to accept an appointment as U.S. ambassador to Japan.
Mondale returned to Minnesota in December and rejoined the law firm of Dorsey & Whitney as a partner, CNA said.
CNA is an insurance holding company with assets of $60.7 billion for the 12 months that ended December 31.
Its shares were trading up 3/4 Wednesday at 106-7/8.
